ui.helpWallpaperQ: Do I need to change my Mac wallpaper?
ui.helpWallpaperA: Not really. Iconland draws its scenery above the system wallpaper, so whichever wallpaper you pick in macOS barely matters — dynamic or rotating wallpapers are fine too.
ui.helpWallpaperStep1: To change the system wallpaper anyway, open System Settings → Wallpaper.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: If the scenery flickers or disappears, click the Iconland icon in the menu bar and choose Reload.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: If the problem persists, quit Iconland and open it again.

host.welcomeBody:
Click the beach icon in the menu bar at the top of the screen to open the menu.
Can't see it? The menu bar may be too full — try hiding some other menu bar icons.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: macOS kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so Iconland has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.

beach.name: Beach
beach.desc: The shoreline curves around your files as waves roll up the sand

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

sigma.label: Distance from icons
sigma.hint: How far the shoreline sits from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the shoreline twists and turns

shoal.label: Clear shallows
shoal.hint: How wide the see-through water over the sand is

shallow.label: Shallow sea
shallow.hint: How far the water fades from turquoise to deep blue

meadow.name: Meadow
meadow.desc: A pen-and-wash meadow where your icons hide in white clouds that cast dark green shadows

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the meadow
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open meadow

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

showBoy.label: Show boy
showBoy.hint: Show or hide the boy together with his kite

showCat.label: Show kitten
showCat.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass

woods.name: Woods
woods.desc: A storybook forest seen from above: icons rest in sunny clearings, dirt paths wind between them, and the round crowns sway in the wind.

sigma.label: Clearing size
sigma.hint: How much open grass surrounds the icons

density.label: Tree density
density.hint: Denser woods have smaller, more crowded crowns

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: How much the tree crowns sway

autumn.label: Autumn
autumn.hint: Share of trees turned orange, gold and red

life.label: Wildlife
life.hint: Birds flying over, butterflies, and a fox now and then

highsea.name: High Sea
highsea.desc: Looking straight down on the open ocean: your icons rest in big white clouds that cast soft shadows on the deep blue water

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the sea
cover.hint: How many small clouds drift over the open water

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

life.label: Ships and whales
life.hint: A small ship passing now and then, and a pod of whales that rarely surfaces to breathe

pond.name: Pond
pond.desc: A calm watercolor pond: icons rest on grassy banks while clear water, lily pads, drifting cloud reflections, water striders and dragonflies fill the rest of the desktop.

sigma.label: Land size
sigma.hint: How far the grass extends around icons

lilies.label: Lily pads
lilies.hint: How many lily pads and flowers float on the water

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: Speed of ripples, cloud reflections and insects

cloudsky.name: Cloud Sky
cloudsky.desc: Cheerful cartoon sky: your icons rest on puffy clouds, and the sky follows your clock from blue day to sunset to starry night

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the cloud under your icons spreads out

tod.label: Time of day
tod.hint: Auto follows your Mac's local time: day, dusk or night

cover.label: Background clouds
cover.hint: How many little clouds drift by in the distance

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast clouds drift, the balloon and birds fly, and stars twinkle

archipelago.name: Archipelago
archipelago.desc: A deep tropical ocean seen from above: your icons become lush islands ringed by surf and turquoise lagoons, and little sailing ships voyage between them

sigma.label: Island size
sigma.hint: How far the islands reach out from your icons

warp.label: Winding coast
warp.hint: How much the island shorelines twist and turn

ships.label: Sailing ships
ships.hint: How many ships sail between the islands; 0 to hide

waves.label: Waves
waves.hint: How many wave crests on open water and light ripples in the shallows

oldmap.name: Old Sea Chart
oldmap.desc: An antique hand-inked sea chart on aged parchment: little ships sail the dotted routes between the islands, and your icons hide in old-map clouds. Click a ship to take the helm: WASD or arrows, click to sail there, Esc to let it go: it sails on to the nearest harbour

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds covering your icons reach

billow.label: Billow size
billow.hint: How big the round puffs along the cloud edge are

islands.label: Islands
islands.hint: How many islands are on the chart and how large they are

details.label: Map details
details.hint: How many map symbols (hills, woods, towns), wave marks and how much shore stippling

life.label: Ships & sea creatures
life.hint: Little ships sailing the routes between the islands, and now and then a sea monster: a sea serpent, the kraken or a ghost ship

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the ships sail, the clouds billow and the monsters appear

oldland.name: Old Land Map
oldland.desc: An antique hand-inked map of a land: forests, mountains, rivers and towns that stay put, with horse carriages slowly travelling the roads between them. Icons rest in little lakes or on open plains.

sigma.label: Lake & plain size
sigma.hint: How large the lakes and open plains around icons are

forest.label: Forest density
forest.hint: How much of the map is covered with forest

details.label: Map details
details.hint: Amount of mountains, hills and grass tufts

carriages.label: Carriages
carriages.hint: Horse carriages travelling the roads between towns

anthill.name: Ant Colony
anthill.desc: A sunny patch of forest floor seen from above: every group of icons becomes an anthill, and ants run along worn trails between the nests, carrying crumbs, sugar and berries home. Now and then a ladybug wanders by

sigma.label: Anthill size
sigma.hint: How far the anthills under your icons spread

ants.label: Number of ants
ants.hint: How many ants are out and about (more nests, more ants)

food.label: Food
food.hint: How often crumbs, sugar cubes, berries and leaves turn up

trails.label: Ant trails
trails.hint: Where ants walk often, a lighter path is slowly worn into the soil

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the ants and the ladybug crawl

details.label: Ground details
details.hint: How many pebbles, fallen leaves, pine needles and twigs, plus the grass and clover along the edges

winterlake.name: Winter Lake
winterlake.desc: A frozen lake seen from above: your icons melt pools of open water in the ice, and when you move one its pool freezes over. Skaters glide around the pools and leave traces (put an icon in a skater's way and they may fall in), a snowman and an ice fisherman keep their distance, and snow falls.

sigma.label: Melt pool size
sigma.hint: How far the open water spreads around your icons

skaters.label: Skaters
skaters.hint: How many people skate on the lake

extras.label: Snowman and fisherman
extras.hint: They sit away from your icons and move when icons come close

cover.label: Snow on the ice
cover.hint: How much of the ice is covered by wind-blown snow drifts

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the skaters, snow and steam move

blockworld.name: Block World
blockworld.desc: A blocky pixel-art world seen from above: your icons stand on flat lawns ringed with lantern-lit gravel walks, among cubic trees, lakes, terraced hills and snowy peaks. Move an icon and the land is rebuilt block by block.

sigma.label: Clearing size
sigma.hint: How far the flat lawn spreads around your icons

trees.label: Forest
trees.hint: How much of the land is covered with trees

water.label: Lakes
water.hint: How much of the world is water

animals.label: Animals
animals.hint: How many sheep, cows, pigs and hens wander the meadows

tod.label: Time of day
tod.hint: Auto follows your Mac's local time; at night the lanterns light the clearings

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the water shimmers, clouds drift and animals walk

space.name: Deep Space
space.desc: The calm dark one: your icons glow inside nebulae in a sky full of stars, while comets, a ringed planet and a little rocket pass by

sigma.label: Nebula size
sigma.hint: How far the glowing gas spreads out from your icons

glow.label: Nebula brightness
glow.hint: How brightly the gas glows; the area right under the icons always stays dark

palette.label: Colours
palette.hint: Mixed gives separate nebulae different colours

stars.label: Stars
stars.hint: How many stars fill the sky

life.label: Comets, rockets and planets
life.hint: How often comets and shooting stars pass, and how many rockets and planets there are

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the gas drifts, stars twinkle and everything flies

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk
cyberpunk.desc: A rain-soaked neon megacity at night, seen from above. Wherever your icons are, a block has burnt out: the buildings around it are on fire, and fire engines, police, ambulances and firefighting drones rush in from all sides to put it out.

sigma.label: Disaster zone size
sigma.hint: How far the burnt-out area under your icons reaches before the burning buildings begin

palette.label: Neon colours
palette.hint: The colours of the signs and the haze

traffic.label: Traffic
traffic.hint: How many cars drive the streets and fly over the city

rain.label: Rain
rain.hint: Rain streaks, ripples and the occasional soft lightning

glitch.label: Glitch
glitch.hint: How often and how strongly the picture glitches for a moment; 0 turns it off

speed.label: Animation speed
speed.hint: How fast the traffic, the signs and the rain move

units.label: Emergency units
units.hint: How many fire engines, police cars, ambulances and drones respond; 0 leaves the fire alone
